# `ipfs mcp` configuration reference

<!-- Generated by docs/mcp/config_reference.py from mcp/contract/config/ipfs-mcp-config.schema.json and docs/mcp/config-reference.tests.json. Do not edit by hand: change the schema or the sidecar and run `python3 docs/mcp/config_reference.py --write`. -->

Every setting of `ipfs mcp`: the config file keys, the command-line options, the environment variables and the build tags, each with its default, its off switch and the tests that run it in that state. For how to use them, see the [user guide](user-guide.md), the [agentic guide](agentic.md), the [embeddings guide](embeddings.md) and the [chat setup](chat-setup.md).

None of these is a Kubo repo config key. `ipfs mcp` never reads or writes `$IPFS_PATH/config`, and nothing here appears in [`docs/config.md`](../config.md). The config file is a separate JSON file named by `--mcp-config=<path>` or `IPFS_MCP_CONFIG` (the flag wins); without either, no file is read and every key takes its default. The root `--config` flag keeps its Kubo meaning. The file is validated against the schema at start, unknown keys are rejected, and credentials are always references (`{"env": "NAME"}` or `{"file": "/absolute/path"}`), never literal values. No key has a default network endpoint.

Precedence: a command-line option wins over its environment variable, which wins over the config file, which wins over the default.

## Features enabled by default in this fork

| Feature | Where it is on | Off switch | Disabled-state test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Local `ipfs mcp` agent endpoint on loopback | IPFS Desktop starts `ipfs mcp --http --agui` on `127.0.0.1` (port 5050 preferred) as a supervised child. Stock `ipfs mcp` stays off: it serves no HTTP and no `/agui` without `--http` and `--agui`. | Desktop: the tray toggle, or `mcpSidecar.enabled` = `false` in the Desktop store. Stock: leave `--http` and `--agui` unset. | Desktop `test/unit/mcp-sidecar.spec.js`: `mcpSidecar.enabled=false starts no child and binds no port`, `is on by default`. Kubo: `TestAGUIIsNotMountedUnlessEnabled`, `TestSettingsRouteRequiresAdminPrincipal`; the `test/cli` pin of the stock defaults (`agent-features-default-on` 1.3) is being written (name unconfirmed). |
| Web UI agent chat | The fork's Web UI build (`src/agent-chat/`). On by default; it makes no request until an endpoint and token exist, which Desktop supplies and a browser user enters in Settings. | Web UI Settings, Agent chat, `enabled` off (local storage key `ipfs-webui:agent-chat`). Turning it off loads nothing and removes the stored token. | Web UI `src/agent-chat/agent-chat.test.js`: `removes the element and the launcher when switched off, and forgets the token`, `publishes nothing while the chat is off (disabled-state)`; `src/agent-chat/boot.test.js`: `keeps a stored enabled: false for both features` (survival through app boot). Uncommitted in the builder's tree on 2026-10-15; names to be rechecked when it lands. |
| WebMCP read tools | The fork's Web UI build, in a browser that offers WebMCP. `enabled` defaults to on; DNSLink resolution is a separate switch. | Web UI Settings, WebMCP, `enabled` off (local storage key `ipfs-webui:webmcp`). Off registers nothing and sends nothing, and clears the two dependent switches. | Web UI `src/webmcp/webmcp.test.js`: `registers nothing and sends nothing once the person switches it off, and the choice survives a reload`, `registers nothing on a profile that opted out, even when the browser has WebMCP`; `boot.test.js` as above. |
| WebMCP write tools | Off by default and per page load. This one does not ship enabled: `writes` is never persisted and every write still needs your confirmation. | Already off at every load. Switch `writes` off in Settings, or use "Deny all and turn off agent writes" in the confirmation dialog. | Web UI `src/webmcp/webmcp.test.js`: `adds write tools only under the second switch, and removes them when it goes off`, `the confirmation hook itself declines when writes are off`. |
| Desktop agent chat bridge | IPFS Desktop: supplies the chat endpoint and token (safeStorage) to the Web UI. Store key `agentChat.enabled`, default on; the chat is still inert without a valid endpoint. | `agentChat.enabled` = `false` in the Desktop store. A stored `false` is never overwritten by the default migration (D18). | Desktop `test/unit/agent-defaults.spec.js`: `a stored false survives app start, for each switch`, `disabled state: chat reads off with a stored false even when an endpoint is set`; `test/unit/agent-chat.spec.js`: `disabled state: registers no channel at all`. |
| Desktop confirmation window | IPFS Desktop on macOS and Linux. Never on Windows (`win32`): the feature is inert there and the tray entries are greyed out. Store key `desktopConfirm.enabled`, default on. Writes still need confirmation. | `desktopConfirm.enabled` = `false` in the Desktop store, the tray "Turn off" entry, or "Turn off" in the pairing or request window. | Desktop `test/unit/agent-confirm.spec.js`: `a hand-written off value in the store keeps it off after a restart`, `win32: inert, and the tray entries are greyed out`; `test/unit/agent-defaults.spec.js`: `never switches the confirmation window on for win32`, `disabled state: a stored false keeps the confirmation window off after the defaults ran`. |
| Desktop settings bridge | IPFS Desktop: the `ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.*` bridge to the sidecar's settings API. Store key `agentSettings.enabled`, default on; the bridge needs the sidecar's `admin` principal, which Desktop configures. | `agentSettings.enabled` = `false` in the Desktop store: no channel exists and nothing is pushed. | Desktop `test/unit/agent-settings-bridge.spec.js`: `with the switch off no channel exists and nothing is pushed`, `the store key defaults to on and reads false as off, like the sidecar switch`. |
| Settings API (`agent.settings.enabled`) | `ipfs mcp`, key `agent.settings.enabled` defaults to `true`, but the route is mounted only when an `admin` principal is configured, so a stock `ipfs mcp` serves no settings route. Desktop and the LKE manifest configure one. | `agent.settings.enabled: false`: the route answers 404, nothing is written and nothing is dialed. Or configure no `admin` principal. | `TestSettingsRouteDisabledAnswers404`, `TestSettingsRouteRequiresAdminPrincipal` (`test/cli/mcp_settings_disabled_test.go`). |
| Server-emitted A2UI surfaces (`agent.a2ui`) | `ipfs mcp`, key `agent.a2ui` defaults to `true` wherever `/agui` is on; no effect when `agent.agui` is false. | `agent.a2ui: false`: no A2UI surface message is emitted on `/agui`; the run stream is otherwise unchanged and the client-side tool-call card renders. | `TestNoA2UISurfaceEventsWhenDisabled` (`mcp/server/agui_a2ui_test.go`). |
| Web UI vector search (`search.enabled`) | The fork's Web UI build (`src/search/`). On by default; it is effective only when the node has a configured index (an `embeddings` section with `search_route.enabled` not `false`) and the chat endpoint and token exist; otherwise it shows the not-configured state and makes no request. | Web UI Settings, Agent features, the Search switch off; or on the node, remove the `embeddings` section or set `search_route.enabled` to `false` (`/index/search` and `/index/status` then answer 404). | Web UI `src/settings/agent/SearchSwitch.test.js`, `src/search/SearchPage.test.js` and `test/e2e/search.test.js` (the switch in Settings, Agent features; the disabled state makes no request). |
| Desktop search (`search.enabled`) | Off by default. IPFS Desktop adds search only after you turn it on. | Desktop Search settings, the search switch off (the default). | Desktop `agent-search.spec.js`. |

The default-on rows follow the fork rule in AGENTS.md (User Agency): an off switch is not a default-off requirement, and each feature keeps a documented off switch. No third-party service is enabled without the operator choosing it: the model backend, the embedder, the extractor and the describer all stay unconfigured until you name them.

Resource use: Idle resident memory of the `ipfs mcp` child as Desktop launches it: 42336 KB (about 41.3 MiB), steady across five samples taken 6 s apart, no model backend configured, no tool call or chat run, one run on one macOS arm64 machine ([evidence](../../mcp/server/evidence/2026-10-14-desktop-sidecar-idle-rss/README.md)). The Electron main process cost of supervising the child and the cost under load are not included.

## Config file keys

### `$schema`

| Key | Type | Default | Flag or variable | Off switch | Tests (off or default state) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string | none | - | Editor hint only; ignored. | `TestConfigExamplesValidate` |

### `http`

| Key | Type | Default | Flag or variable | Off switch | Tests (off or default state) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `http` | object | `{}` | - | Omit the section or leave http.enabled false. | `TestHTTPDefaultsMatchTheContract`, `TestMCP` |
| `http.enabled` | boolean | `false` | `--http` | false (default): no listener is opened; stdio only. **This build:** `--http=false` overrides `http.enabled: true`: the flag wins in either direction, and the file decides only when the flag is not given. | `TestHTTPDefaultsMatchTheContract`, `TestMCP`, `TestHTTPFlagFalseOverridesConfigEnabled` |
| `http.listen` | ListenAddress | `"127.0.0.1:5050"` | `--http=<addr>`; `IPFS_MCP_HTTP_LISTEN` | Used only when http.enabled is true. Reserved ports of other local services are rejected. | `TestParseListenForms`, `TestHTTPListenerRefusals`, `TestReservedPortsMatchTheContractSchema` |
| `http.allowed_origins` | array of Origin | `[]` | - | Empty (default): every cross-origin request to /mcp is rejected. | `TestHTTPRequestHardening`, `TestHTTPAllowedOriginGetsCORSHeaders` |
| `http.max_body_bytes` | integer | `4194304` | - | Always enforced; lower it to reject larger requests. | `TestHTTPRequestHardening`, `TestMountedRouteBodyLimitApplies` |
| `http.session_timeout` | Duration | `"30m"` | - | Idle sessions end after this duration. | `TestSessionTimeoutIsConfigurable`, `TestIdleSessionsExpire` |

### `principals`

| Key | Type | Default | Flag or variable | Off switch | Tests (off or default state) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `principals` | array of object | `[]` | - | Empty (default): no ui, a2a, uar or admin principal exists, HTTP has no authenticated principal and the settings route is not mounted (404). A loopback listener with no principal and no operator token configured at all serves every request as the anonymous-loopback principal, which is read-only (confirmation class none tools only; no write or destructive group can be granted to it). A non-loopback listener without a verifier is refused. When principals are configured but none of them has a credential that resolves (and no --auth-token-* operator token is given), startup fails and names the principals and the environment variables or files it expected; it does not fall back to the anonymous listener. When some resolve, only those are enabled. **This build:** The anonymous listener refuses (403) any request that carries `Forwarded`, `X-Forwarded-For` or `X-Real-IP`: a proxied request did not come from this machine, so behind a reverse proxy a credential (an operator bearer token or configured principals) is required. | `TestHTTPAnonymousLoopbackIsReadOnly`, `TestMCPPrincipalUnconfiguredGetsNothing`, `TestAnonymousListenerRefusesForwardedRequests` |
| `principals[].name` | string | none | - | Remove the principal entry: its credential then authenticates nothing. | `TestUnknownTokenGetsNothing`, `TestPrincipalConfigRules` |
| `principals[].kind` | string | none | - | Remove the principal entry. | `TestHTTPPrincipalKindsAreScopedToRoutes`, `TestA2AEndpointRejectsOtherPrincipalKinds`, `TestAdminPrincipalScopedToSettingsRoute`, `TestAdminPrincipalHasNoToolGrants` |
| `principals[].credential` | SecretRef | none | - | Remove the principal entry, or remove the env variable or file it names: an unknown token gets 401. If the named environment variable or file is absent, only that principal is disabled, with a warning at start: startup proceeds and the principal authenticates nothing until the reference resolves (CRITICAL-2). | `TestAbsentCredentialDisablesOnlyThatPrincipal`, `TestAllCredentialsAbsentServerStarts`, `TestConfigCredentialsDisableAPrincipalWhoseSecretIsAbsent`, `TestParseConfigRejectsLiteralSecretsAndReservedPorts` |
| `principals[].groups` | array of GroupOrAll | `["*"]` | - | List fewer groups; an empty list grants no tool. Read-class tools only. | `TestHTTPScopesNarrowTheToolList`, `TestHTTPToolOutsideGrantsIsRefusedWithoutRunning` |
| `principals[].write_groups` | array of Group | `[]` | - | Empty (default): the principal is read-only. | `TestConfigPrincipalsAreReadOnlyUnlessGranted`, `TestReadOnlyPrincipalListsNoWriteTool` |
| `principals[].destructive_groups` | array of Group | `[]` | - | Empty (default): no destructive-class tool (pin_rm, mfs_rm, key_rm, repo_gc) is offered to the principal (ADR-0003 section 2). | `TestConfigPrincipalsAreReadOnlyUnlessGranted`, `TestKeyRmIsOffByDefault` |
| `principals[].egress_ack` | array of Host | `[]` | - | Empty (default): every contentEgress tool is refused to this principal with egress_not_acknowledged. | `TestEveryContentEgressToolIsRefusedWithoutAck`, `TestMCPPrincipalEgressAckIsRequiredForContentTools` |
| `principals[].shell_capable` | boolean or null | none | - | Operator assertion. Under confirmation.cli a write principal needs false, otherwise its write and destructive grants are refused. | `TestShellCapableNotRequiredWithoutCLIConfirmation`, `TestMCPPrincipalShellCapableIsRequiredUnderConfirmCLI` |
| `principals[].check` | string | `"verify"` | - | verify (default) fails closed when UAR settings are unreadable; assert records the operator's own verification. Only used for kind uar. | `TestUARUnreadableSettingsFailClosedUnlessAsserted`, `TestMCPPrincipalUARVerifyIsRefusedWhenSettingsAreUnreadable` |
| `principals[].uar` | object or null | none | - | null (default); required only for kind uar. | `TestNoUARContactWithoutAUARPrincipal` |
| `principals[].uar.card_url` | string | none | - | Remove the uar block: no check-uar connection is made. | `TestNoUARContactWithoutAUARPrincipal`, `TestCheckUARDoesNotFollowRedirects` |
| `principals[].uar.admin_credential` | SecretRef or null | none | - | null (default): settings cannot be read, so check verify fails closed. | `TestCheckUARNeverSendsTheAdminCredentialInCleartext` |
| `principals[].uar.min_version` | string or null | none | - | null (default): the version pinned by the shipped UAR profile applies. | `TestUARVersionGate`, `TestUARPrincipalExampleUsesThePinnedMinimum` |

## Command-line options

Global options such as `--api` and `--api-auth` keep their Kubo meaning (see `ipfs --help`); `ipfs mcp` uses them to reach the daemon. Give the RPC secret with `--api-auth-env` or `--api-auth-file` instead of `--api-auth`, which puts it in the process list (`ipfs mcp` warns when it is used). In a build with the `noagent` tag the `--llm-*`, `--agui` and `--a2a` options do not exist.

### `ipfs mcp`

| Option | Config key | Meaning, default and off switch | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tools` | `tools.groups` | Same as `tools.groups`. Default `["node", "content", "pin", "mfs", "names", "dag", "routing", "diag", "index"]`. Off: Remove a group to disable it. Destructive-class tools are excluded by default; add the selector destructive to enable them (still confirmed per call). | `TestSelectionDisabledGroupAndReadOnly`, `TestFlagsOverrideConfigFile` |
| `--read-only` | `tools.read_only` | Same as `tools.read_only`. Default `false`. Off: true: only confirmation-class none tools are offered. | `TestReadOnlyModeHidesRoutingWritesAndGc` |
| `--http` | `http.enabled` | Same as `http.enabled`. Default `false`. Off: false (default): no listener is opened; stdio only. | `TestHTTPDefaultsMatchTheContract`, `TestMCP` |
| `--mcp-config` | - | Path of the `ipfs mcp` JSON config file described on this page. Also `IPFS_MCP_CONFIG`; the flag wins. Not the Kubo repo config: the root `--config` flag keeps its Kubo meaning. Default: none, and then no file is read and every key takes its default. Off: leave it and `IPFS_MCP_CONFIG` unset. | `TestParseConfigDefaults`, `TestLoadConfigReportsTheFile` |
| `--auth-token-env` | - | Name of an environment variable whose value is a bearer token for the operator identity over HTTP (every group readable and writable; destructive only with `destructive` in `--tools`). Default: none. Off: leave unset; a loopback listener then serves read-only tools to local processes, and a non-loopback listener is refused. | `TestHTTPAnonymousLoopbackIsReadOnly`, `TestOperatorIdentityFollowsTheDestructiveSelector` |
| `--auth-token-file` | - | Absolute path of a file holding the operator bearer token; same meaning as `--auth-token-env`. Use one of the two. Default: none. Off: leave unset. | `TestHTTPAnonymousLoopbackIsReadOnly`, `TestSecretRefReadsEnvAndFiles` |
| `--api-auth-env` | - | Name of an environment variable holding the daemon's RPC API secret (an `API.Authorizations` entry, for example `bearer:<secret>`). Use one of `--api-auth-env`, `--api-auth-file` and the global `--api-auth`; the global flag puts the secret in the process list and prints a warning. Default: none. Off: leave unset; requests to the daemon carry no secret. | `TestResolveAPIAuth`, `TestResolveAPIAuthRefusals` |
| `--api-auth-file` | - | Absolute path of a file holding the daemon's RPC API secret; same meaning as `--api-auth-env`. Default: none. Off: leave unset. | `TestResolveAPIAuth`, `TestResolveAPIAuthRefusals` |
| `--no-app-views` | `tools.app_views` | Same as `tools.app_views`. Default `true`. Off: false: no ui:// resource is registered and no tool carries _meta.ui; every tool is still offered and returns the same result. With true, a view is served only while at least one of its linked tools is registered (ADR-0007 section 5). | `TestAppViewsOffSwitch`, `TestMCPAppViewsOff` |
| `--print-rpc-allowed-paths` | - | Prints an `API.Authorizations` entry whose `AllowedPaths` list only the RPC commands of the enabled tools (honors `--tools`, `--read-only` and `tools.disabled`), then exits without contacting the daemon. Default: false. Nothing to turn off. | `TestRPCAllowedPathsFollowTheToolSelection`, `TestRPCAuthorizationEntryIsJSONWithoutARealSecret` |
| `--confirm` | `confirmation.modes` | Same as `confirmation.modes`. Default `["native"]`. Off: Leaving desktop out (the default) keeps the paired Desktop channel off. Empty list, --confirm=none or IPFS_MCP_CONFIRM=none: no out-of-band resolver runs. Per-call confirmation still applies: elicitation is used when the client supports it, otherwise write and destructive calls are refused with confirmation_unavailable. | `TestParseModes`, `TestNoModesBuildsNoResolver`, `TestConfiguredDefaultsToNativeOnly` |
| `--llm-base-url` | `llm.base_url` | Same as `llm.base_url`. Default none. Off: Remove the llm section: no agent surface is mounted and no model call is made. | `TestAgentHasNoDefaultEndpointOrModel`, `TestFlagsOverrideConfigFile` |
| `--llm-model` | `llm.model` | Same as `llm.model`. Default none. Off: Remove the llm section. With llm.kind uar it names the default model of the UAR agent. | `TestAgentHasNoDefaultEndpointOrModel` |
| `--llm-api-key-env` | `llm.api_key` | Same as `llm.api_key`. Default none. Off: null (default): requests carry no key (local servers). An api_key reference whose environment variable or file is absent is never fatal: startup proceeds with a warning, only the dependent agent backend is disabled, and /agui answers 503 backend_not_configured until the reference resolves (CRITICAL-2). | `TestLiteralKeyFlagsAreRejectedAndNeverEchoed` |
| `--llm-api-key-file` | `llm.api_key` | Same as `llm.api_key`. Default none. Off: null (default): requests carry no key (local servers). An api_key reference whose environment variable or file is absent is never fatal: startup proceeds with a warning, only the dependent agent backend is disabled, and /agui answers 503 backend_not_configured until the reference resolves (CRITICAL-2). | `TestKeyOnlyFromEnvOrFile` |
| `--agui` | `agent.agui` | Same as `agent.agui`. Default `false`. Off: false (default): /agui is not mounted (404). | `TestAGUIIsNotMountedUnlessEnabled` |
| `--settings-dir` | `agent.settings.dir` | Same as `agent.settings.dir`. Default none. Off: null (default): no overlay is read or written; the effective settings come from the flags and this file only, and nothing is persisted across restarts. | `TestSettingsOverlayPrecedence` |
| `--a2a` | `agent.a2a` | Same as `agent.a2a`. Default `false`. Off: false (default): /a2a and the agent card are not mounted (404). | `TestA2ADisabledServesNothing` |

### `ipfs mcp check-uar`

| Option | Config key | Meaning, default and off switch | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | - | Name of a `uar` principal in the `--mcp-config` file whose address, admin credential, minimum version, `egress_ack` and check mode are used. Default: none. | `TestMCPPrincipalCheckUAR` |
| `--admin-credential-env` | - | Name of the environment variable holding the UAR admin credential; sent only over https or to a loopback host, never printed. Default: none. | `TestCheckUARNeverSendsTheAdminCredentialInCleartext` |
| `--min-version` | - | Minimum published UAR release (`x.y.z`). Default: the contract's pinned minimum; with neither, the check refuses `min_version_not_set`. | `TestCheckUARVersionMinimumCountsPublishedReleasesOnly` |
| `--egress-ack` | - | Comma-separated hosts the UAR instance may forward content to, or `local`. Default: none. | `TestCheckUARRemoteProviderNeedsMatchingAck` |
| `--check` | - | `verify` (default) or `assert`, as `principals[].check`. | `TestCheckUARUnreadableSettingsFailClosedUnlessAsserted` |

### `ipfs mcp confirm`

No options.

### `ipfs mcp pair`

No options.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Meaning | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| `IPFS_MCP_CONFIG` | Path of the config file when `--mcp-config` is not given. | `TestParseConfigDefaults` |
| `IPFS_MCP_HTTP_LISTEN` | Listen address when `--http` names none; overrides `http.listen`. | `TestParseListenForms` |
| `IPFS_MCP_CONFIRM` | Confirmation modes when `--confirm` is not given; `none` turns the out-of-band resolvers off. Overrides `confirmation.modes`. | `TestParseModes`, `TestNoModesBuildsNoResolver` |
| `IPFS_MCP_CONFIRM_DIR` | Directory of the per-process confirmation sockets used by `ipfs mcp confirm` and the Desktop channel. Default: `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ipfs-mcp`, else `<tmp>/ipfs-mcp-<uid>`. | `TestSocketIsPrivate` |
| `IPFS_MCP_PAIRING_FILE` | File holding the hash of the Desktop pairing key written by `ipfs mcp pair`. Default: `$IPFS_PATH/mcp-confirm-pairing.json`. | `TestPairingStoresOnlyAHash`, `TestDesktopModeWithoutPairingBuildsNoResolver` |

Credential references in the config file name further variables of your choosing (for example `IPFS_MCP_UI_TOKEN`); they are read only when the key that names them is set.

## Build tags

| Tag | Effect | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| `nomcp` | `make build GOTAGS=nomcp` compiles `ipfs mcp` out; the command then only reports that it is not included. | `TestMCPNoMCPBuild` |
| `noagent` | `make build GOTAGS=noagent` compiles out the agent loop, `/agui` and `/a2a`; the `--llm-*`, `--agui` and `--a2a` flags do not exist and an `llm` section is refused. Embeddings stay available. | `TestAgentOffWhenUnconfigured` |

## Value types

| Type | Rule |
|---|---|
| `SecretRef` | A credential reference. Literal secret values are not accepted anywhere. |
| `AbsolutePath` | An absolute filesystem path. Relative paths and PATH lookups are rejected. |
| `Duration` | String matching `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms\|s\|m\|h))+$`. |
| `Group` | One of `node`, `content`, `pin`, `mfs`, `names`, `dag`, `routing`, `diag`, `index`. |
| `GroupOrAll` | One of `node`, `content`, `pin`, `mfs`, `names`, `dag`, `routing`, `diag`, `index`, `*`. |
| `GroupOrSelector` | One of `node`, `content`, `pin`, `mfs`, `names`, `dag`, `routing`, `diag`, `index`, `destructive`. |
| `PeerId` | A libp2p peer ID (base58btc 12D3KooW... or Qm..., or a CIDv1 libp2p-key), the same form as the tool contract's PeerId. |
| `ToolName` | String matching `^(ipfs\|pin\|ipns\|key\|mfs\|dag\|car\|routing\|swarm\|stats\|repo)_[a-z0-9_]+$`. |
| `Host` | A model or embedder host name (optionally with port) the principal's content may be sent to. |
| `Origin` | String matching `^(https?\|webui)://[^/\s]+$`. |
| `ListenAddress` | host:port or a /ip4\|/ip6\|/dns*/.../tcp/<port> multiaddr. Ports reserved for other local services are rejected: 4000, 4001, 5001, 8080, 1906, 1907, 1908, 50051, 8181, 8081, 11434, 23001, 28000. |
